name: Richard Pombo
summary:
Richard William Pombo (born January 8, 1961) is an American politician and lobbyist who represented California's 11th congressional district in the United States House of Representatives from January 3, 1993, to January 3, 2007. A Republican, he chaired the House Resources Committee during the 108th and 109th Congresses, from 2003 to 2007.
A native of Tracy, California, Pombo worked in his family's agricultural businesses before entering local politics.
